results.title: About Us – MM Precision
results.summary: M&M Precision Machining Company is a family-owned CNC precision machining shop based in Timmonsville, South Carolina, established in 1991. With over 30 years of operation, it is veteran-owned and family-operated, offering nationwide machining services. Leadership includes Landry Frison and Melvin Frison, both with military backgrounds. The company emphasizes cutting-edge technology, on-site response for local customers, on-time delivery, and a 100% quality guarantee or money back.

results.title: Sims Machining
results.summary: Sims Machining LLC is a family-owned CNC precision machine shop in Timmonsville, South Carolina, founded in 1979 by Lynn Sims. The shop offers CNC milling, CNC turning, and automatic screw machine grinding, supported by a diverse set of equipment and services. It emphasizes quality, delivery, and pride in workmanship, holds ISO-9001:2008 certification since 2010, and provides local delivery with easy access to I-95 and I-20. results.summary: Lorraine Machine is a family-owned precision CNC machine shop based in Greenville, South Carolina. Founded in 1967, the veteran-owned company specializes in CNC manufacturing for aerospace, automotive, telecom, and related sectors. It emphasizes traceability, documented processes, and quality, with a small team (2–3 employees reported) and a history of steady customer audits. Key details: headquartered in Greenville; homepage lorrainemachine.com; owner/leadership includes President Roger Bouchilion. Official presence on LinkedIn and Facebook.

results.title: About Benchmark | CNC Machine Shop in Summerville & Charleston
results.summary:
Benchmark Machining, Inc. is a family-owned CNC machine shop serving Summerville, Charleston, and the Lowcountry since 1996. Key points:

- Full-service CNC shop handling prototypes to full production runs, with finishing options (plating, anodizing, powder coating, painting, packaging).
- In-house quality: parts inspected with a CMM, material certifications maintained, and per-part QA documentation.
- Emphasis on fast turnarounds across prototypes, small batches, and larger production, with a personal, direct-contact approach rather than a call center.
- Competitive pricing, honest quotes, and dedicated, hands-on service from the same team throughout a project.
